changeSet.author: Abdula Basnukaev
changeSet.comment: Узлы графа (полиморфные через дискриминатор node_type). Enum'ы хранятся как TEXT + CHECK — проще эволюция, чем нативный ENUM Postgres (ADR в antipatterns.md). Индексы на topic_id и status — для выборок по теме и фильтрации по статусу.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE nodes ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), topic_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES topics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, node_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (node_type IN ('QUESTION','CLAIM','ARGUMENT','EVIDENCE')), content TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNVERIFIED' CHECK (status IN ('STANDING','DISPUTED','REFUTED','UNVERIFIED')), weight INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5 CHECK (weight BETWEEN 1 AND 10), created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ); CREATE INDEX idx_nodes_topic_id ON nodes(topic_id); CREATE INDEX idx_nodes_status ON nodes(status); CREATE INDEX idx_nodes_created_by ON nodes(created_by);
